name: Library Adoption
description: An application that needs a job a library already defines refers to the library's solution instead of copying its records, so each job is defined once. The application's records hold three kinds of solution: adopted ones that are only a reference, specialized ones that add what needs the application's data, and its own, which carry its own metrics, customization and code.
purpose: Let a repository refer to a solution that another library's records define, and tell the adopted, the specialized and its own solutions apart, so no job is described twice.
approach: A row of solutions.csv names the library solution it adopts or specializes as @library/solution_id; the library's repository is named in the configuration; the checks resolve each reference and inform of restated jobs; the generated page links an adopted solution to the library's page.
out_of_scope: Reading and writing the records themselves (Intent Registry); running the rules (Structure Check); drawing the pages (Readable Records); reusing the library's measured results, which is a metric building on its foundation (Consumer Check); deciding that two jobs are the same, which a person does.
milestones: 1. Resolution: every reference in the fixtures resolves or is reported with its next action, and all adoption cases pass.
measures_of_success: A reader can name, for each solution of an adopting repository, whether it is adopted, specialized or its own, and no adopted solution restates the library. Standing conditions: every reference resolves to a solution of a readable library.
parameters: The library names and repositories under [adopts] in the configuration.
inputs: The solutions.csv rows with an adopts or specializes cell, and the library's records.
outputs: The references that do not resolve, and for each adopted solution the library's own description and page.
effects: None beyond reading the library's records.
usage_notes: `esoi.run("library-adoption", ".")` lists the references that do not resolve; the steps are in docs/how-to/adopt-a-solution-from-a-library.md.
change_driver: the way people write their records
